model: Separate ordinary least squares for each variant and phenotype, with intercept and both covariates; residual variance uses n minus design rank.
tolerance_rationale: Proposed double-precision rounding allowance for this small full-rank integer fixture against an exact rational calculation. Not approved for production, ill-conditioned inputs or large GWAS.
reference_method: Independent rational Gram-Schmidt projections and triangular solution; residual and coefficient variances are exact rational values until final square root.
